name: Mirrorless interchangeable-lens camera
definition: digital stills and video body with exchangeable lenses and no reflex mirror; any sensor size, medium format included.

name: Digital single-lens reflex camera
definition: digital body with exchangeable lenses and a mirror-and-prism optical viewfinder.

name: Digital rangefinder camera
definition: digital body with a rangefinder focusing and framing window and exchangeable lenses.

name: Compact fixed-lens camera
definition: digital stills camera with a lens that cannot be removed, built small for pocket or carry use.

name: Bridge or superzoom camera
definition: digital stills camera with a fixed long-range zoom lens in a larger, SLR-like body.

name: Camcorder
definition: handheld camera built mainly to record video for long takes, with a fixed or built-in zoom lens.

name: Digital cinema camera
definition: professional motion-picture camera body for cinema or high-end video, with cine mount and cine connectors.

name: Action camera
definition: small rugged camera made to be mounted on a person, helmet, bike or vehicle for video.

name: 360-degree camera
definition: camera with two or more lenses that records a full spherical view.

name: Pocket gimbal camera
definition: small handheld device with a camera fixed to a built-in motorised stabilising gimbal.

name: Trail camera
definition: camera in a weatherproof housing that is left outdoors and triggered by motion, mainly for wildlife (K-156; wildlife is a setting tag).

name: Photo booth
definition: cabinet or stand that combines a camera, light and printer to take pictures of guests (D4-O1).

name: Camera drone
definition: unmanned aircraft made for filming, carrying a stabilised camera (K-97).

name: Film single-lens reflex camera
definition: film body with a mirror-and-prism viewfinder that shows the picture through the taking lens.

name: Film rangefinder camera
definition: film body with a rangefinder window for focusing and framing.

name: Viewfinder or point-and-shoot film camera
definition: film camera with a separate viewfinder and simple controls, including plastic lo-fi cameras that take real pictures.

name: Twin-lens reflex camera
definition: film body with two lenses, one for the waist-level viewing screen and one for taking.

name: View camera
definition: large-format camera with bellows, ground-glass back and lens movements.

name: Box or folding camera
definition: simple box-shaped camera, or one with a folding bellows body, for roll film.

name: Single-use camera
definition: pre-loaded film camera sold to be used once and sent for processing.

name: Pinhole camera
definition: camera whose lens is a small aperture with no glass.

name: Integral-film instant camera
definition: camera that makes a self-developing print on integral instant film.

name: Peel-apart instant camera
definition: camera that uses pack film with a separate negative and positive that are peeled apart.

name: Hybrid instant camera
definition: camera with a digital sensor and screen that also prints on instant film.

name: Prime lens
definition: lens with one fixed focal length.

name: Zoom lens
definition: lens with a variable focal length.

name: Macro lens
definition: lens built to focus close and reproduce small subjects at high magnification.

name: Fisheye lens
definition: ultra-wide lens with a very strong curved (non-rectilinear) projection.

name: Tilt-shift lens
definition: lens whose optics tilt or shift to control perspective and the plane of focus.

name: Anamorphic lens
definition: lens that squeezes the image horizontally for later de-squeezing to a wider frame.

name: Special-effect lens
definition: lens made to give a deliberate effect such as soft focus, swirl or selective blur.

name: Cine lens
definition: lens built for motion-picture work, marked in T-stops, with geared rings and a cine mount.

name: Teleconverter
definition: optical unit fitted between camera and lens that lengthens the focal length.

name: Close-up lens
definition: simple glass element fitted in front of a lens to focus closer.

name: Lens filter
definition: glass or resin disc or plate that fits a lens front to alter the light reaching it.

name: Mount adapter
definition: ring with no optics that fits a lens of one mount to a body of another.

name: Focal reducer
definition: mount adapter with optics that shorten the focal length and widen the aperture while changing mounts.

name: Speedlight (flashgun)
definition: small battery flash that mounts on the camera hot shoe or a stand.

name: Studio monolight (strobe head)
definition: self-contained studio flash head with its own power supply and modelling lamp.

name: Studio flash pack and head
definition: studio flash whose power pack is separate from one or more flash heads.

name: LED panel
definition: flat panel of LEDs giving constant light.

name: COB LED light
definition: single chip-on-board LED source, usually in a reflector or with a modifier mount.

name: Fresnel light
definition: constant light with a stepped Fresnel lens that focuses the beam.

name: Ring light
definition: circular light source made to surround the lens or the subject's face.

name: Softbox
definition: fabric box with a diffusion front that softens a light placed behind it (strip box and octabox are non-maker named forms).

name: Umbrella
definition: umbrella-shaped reflector or shoot-through diffuser for a light.

name: Reflector dish
definition: metal bowl that directs light from a flash head.

name: Portable reflector or diffuser
definition: collapsible disc or panel that bounces or diffuses light.

name: Beauty dish
definition: shallow dish with a central deflector that gives a crisp, wrapped light.

name: Snoot
definition: tube that narrows a light to a small circle.

name: Grid
definition: honeycomb or egg-crate that narrows and straightens a beam.

name: Barn doors
definition: hinged flaps fitted to a light to cut and shape the beam.

name: Gobo
definition: pattern or shape cutout placed in a beam to project a shadow or pattern.

name: Colour gel
definition: coloured or correction sheet fitted over a light.

name: Light stand
definition: adjustable stand that carries a light or modifier (the C-stand is a non-maker named form).

name: Boom arm
definition: counterweighted arm that carries a light overhead.

name: Backdrop stand
definition: stand and crossbar that hold a studio backdrop (R-1; the backdrop itself is B2).

name: Tripod
definition: three-legged stand for a camera.

name: Tabletop tripod
definition: very short tripod for a table or surface.

name: Tripod head
definition: separate head (ball, pan-and-tilt, fluid, gimbal, panoramic) that mounts on a tripod or monopod.

name: Quick-release system
definition: plate, L-bracket or collar that lets a camera or lens click on and off a support.

name: Monopod
definition: single-leg support.

name: Handheld gimbal stabiliser
definition: motorised handheld stabiliser for a camera.

name: Camera rig
definition: shoulder or frame system that carries a camera with accessories.

name: Camera cage
definition: frame that fits around a camera body and gives it mounting points.

name: Camera mount and clamp
definition: clamp or bracket that fixes a camera to a pole, rail, window or vehicle.

name: Black-and-white negative film
definition: panchromatic negative film processed in black-and-white chemistry.

name: Colour negative film (C-41)
definition: still-photography colour negative film processed in the C-41 process.

name: Colour negative film (ECN-2, motion picture)
definition: cinema colour negative stock processed in the ECN-2 process.

name: Colour reversal film (E-6)
definition: slide film processed in the E-6 process to a positive.

name: Integral instant film
definition: self-developing film in a frame that develops in the print itself.

name: Peel-apart instant film
definition: instant film pack whose negative and positive are separated after development.

name: Developing tank
definition: light-tight tank in which film is processed.

name: Developing reel
definition: spiral reel that holds film in a tank.

name: Changing bag
definition: light-proof bag for loading film into a tank.

name: Enlarger
definition: darkroom projector that exposes a negative onto paper (condenser, diffusion or colour dichroic: `enlarger_type` attribute).

name: Enlarging lens
definition: lens made to project a negative in an enlarger.

name: Enlarging easel
definition: frame that holds paper flat under an enlarger.

name: Focus finder
definition: magnifier used to focus the projected grain.

name: Darkroom timer
definition: timer that controls the enlarger or safelight.

name: Enlarger filter
definition: multigrade or colour filter for the enlarger.

name: Developing tray
definition: shallow tray for print chemistry.

name: Safelight
definition: darkroom lamp that does not fog paper.

name: Print dryer
definition: equipment for drying prints.

name: Photographic chemistry
definition: developer, stop, fixer and related chemistry (`chemical_type` attribute).

name: Photographic printing paper
definition: light-sensitive paper for prints (K-156; `paper_process`: silver-gelatin fibre or resin-coated, chromogenic, inkjet photo paper).

name: Camera bag or case
definition: bag, backpack or case made to carry a camera and lenses.

name: Camera strap
definition: strap or sling that carries a camera.

name: Camera battery
definition: rechargeable battery made for a camera.

name: Camera battery charger
definition: charger made for a camera battery.

name: Battery grip
definition: grip that adds a second battery and controls to a camera body.

name: Viewfinder or eyepiece
definition: viewfinder, eyepiece or magnifier fitted to a camera.

name: Remote shutter release
definition: cable or wireless release for a camera, including camera-specific cables.

name: Light meter (exposure and flash)
definition: handheld meter that measures light for exposure.

name: Camera cleaning kit
definition: kit for cleaning a lens or sensor.

name: Underwater housing
definition: waterproof case made for a camera.

name: Lens hood
definition: shade that fits the front of a lens.

name: Lens cap
definition: cover for the front or rear of a lens.

name: Telescope camera adapter
definition: T-ring or adapter that fits a camera to a telescope.
